compiled_state.title: Integration tests for Anthropic and OpenAI providers against fixture corpus
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD1: integration test exercising each provider end-to-end against fixture diffs

## Implementation
tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_integration.py:
- Use fixture-diff.txt from tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/
- Use respx.MockRouter to intercept api.anthropic.com and api.openai.com
- Mock response bodies match each provider's API schema:
  - Anthropic: {"content": [{"text": "{\"findings\": [...]}"}], "stop_reason": "end_turn"}
  - OpenAI: {"choices": [{"message": {"content": "{\"findings\": [...]}"}}]}
- test_anthropic_provider_integration: AnthropicProvider().review_diff(corpus_diff) returns {"findings": list}
- test_openai_provider_integration: OpenAIProvider().review_diff(corpus_diff) returns {"findings": list}

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Integration test file exists with both test functions
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_integration.py && grep -q "test_anthropic_provider_integration" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_integration.py && grep -q "test_openai_provider_integration" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_integration.py
- [ ] Both tests pass
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_providers_integration.py -x

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
